purpose: Five non-random grading calibration cases, not a retrieval benchmark score.

reranker_ablation_capture.review: Completed manual nonblind paired support review at bb047b9: inspected changed passages and shared supporting witnesses. Both modes have26 full,3 partial and1 missing answers under the existing criteria. No coverage gain demonstrated; ordering and distracting passages differ. This is not independent grading or generated-answer evaluation.
reranker_ablation_capture.decision: Do not disable reranking based on the interpretability miss. Qwen cache has no safetensors/bin weights; no alternate-model download performed.

source_title_interpretability_probe.method: Prefix the verified first-page title Attention Is All You Need to every existing candidate for question7; retain original chunks, query, MiniLM model and final5. PDF title metadata is empty, so first-line verification is specific to this paper.
source_title_interpretability_probe.conclusion: Title context alone does not recover the supporting chunk. Neither tested boundary-only nor title-only intervention justifies a runtime fix. Stop tailoring this one query; compare reranker suitability across the fixed suite before selecting further changes.

intact_interpretability_paragraph_probe.method: Same question7/candidate pool/MiniLM on CUDA; replace only chunk39 text with the manually selected complete source paragraph from PDF page7. Normalize whitespace and the fi ligature. Recompute all scores for baseline and intervention.
intact_interpretability_paragraph_probe.conclusion: Keeping the paragraph intact alone does not recover the answer in final5. This oracle diagnostic does not justify deploying paragraph chunking as the fix for this miss. Source identity context and reranker suitability remain unresolved; retrieval of a newly indexed paragraph was not tested.

interpretability_failure_trace.finding: The paragraph is extracted and its first part reaches the candidate pool, but not final5. MiniLM demotes chunk39 from fused rank12 to17. The source paragraph is split between chunks39/40, mixed with preceding convolution complexity and following training details. Thus this is not missing extraction; both candidate ordering and passage boundaries merit attention.
interpretability_failure_trace.next: Evaluate paragraph-preserving boundaries and reranker behavior without increasing the final result limit to hide the miss. No runtime heuristic adopted from this single case.

repeated_resource_diagnostic_2026_09_13.conclusion: GPU allocated/reserved memory was constant at round boundaries; RSS fluctuated and ended about 25 MB higher. Close did not immediately release the model-sized CUDA allocation. No forced garbage collection was used. Investigate cleanup/cycles before claiming deterministic release; this short sequential single-index run does not establish sustained or concurrent production readiness.

cached_runtime_replay_2026_09_13.method: Fixed 30 questions, existing 79-chunk index and cached API query vectors; current runtime with real cached MiniLM reranking on auto-selected CUDA. Source and query hashes verified. Provider requests, Python socket connections and reindexing forbidden.
cached_runtime_replay_2026_09_13.conclusion: No observed retrieval-evidence regression on this fixed paper; prior support limitations remain. Not a quality improvement, fresh parser/index-build test, Qwen-reranker evaluation or independent grading. Timing is one local run, not a performance benchmark.

caption_boundaries_integrated_result.method: Same public PDF/30 questions, model, cached unprefixed query vectors, candidate20/final5 and actual MiniLM reranker. Re-embed changed document chunks into isolated temporary storage. Caption-aware parsing/chunking is the experimental variable.

gains.note: Figure4 caption explicitly identifies anaphora resolution. Grade the asked phenomenon; caption references 'its' but does not independently explain both antecedent alternatives in the reference parenthesis.

caption_boundaries_integrated_result.preservation_check: For23 previously full cases, all entire previously cited supporting passages occur in new returned evidence after whitespace normalization. The remaining full case24 was manually rechecked: Table4's semi-supervised Transformer92.7 is now rank1. Thus no prior full case lost support under this rubric.
caption_boundaries_integrated_result.remaining: Indices0/21/27 remain partial;7 remains missing. Source BLEU inconsistency persists.
caption_boundaries_integrated_result.verification: 295 unit/citation/generation/refresh regressions pass. One public-document benchmark, manual non-blind grading; not a broad production guarantee or inference-throughput comparison.

caption_dilution_diagnostic.method: Same cached MiniLM model and question; compare original chunk73, its existing caption-only suffix, and complete contiguous Figure4 caption extracted from source p14. No new retrieval or embeddings.
caption_dilution_diagnostic.conclusion: Removing preceding repeated diagram labels substantially improves this caption's relevance score, even without adding missing caption text. Both caption variants exceed the unchanged original corpus fifth score. This supports testing caption-aware segmentation, not deleting diagram text or claiming an integrated retrieval improvement.
caption_dilution_diagnostic.alternate_model_preflight: Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B snapshot has tokenizer/config files but no model weights; no Qwen inference or download attempted.

qwen_query_instruction_ablation.method: Change only embedding query input; same model, public stored document vectors, queries, lexical ranks, candidate20/final5. Reuse saved cross-encoder scores because reranker query and passage text are unchanged.
qwen_query_instruction_ablation.conclusion: Recommended query instruction does not improve final evidence on this suite. Figure4 answer is already among vector candidates and reaches fused rank1 in the instructed run, but the cached MiniLM reranker still removes it from the final five. Do not credit a query-format change with fixing this reranker error.

neighbor_context_ablation.method: Keep actual runtime final-five ranks fixed; add up to350 contiguous source characters before/after each passage, trimming edge words. No new embeddings, reranking, merged results or generation.

reviewed_changes.note: Preceding source sentence supplies explicit joint attention to different subspaces and positions.
Following Table3 text supplies the single-head row and24.9, with table header/base row for context.
Now includes adding positional encodings to embeddings, but not sine/cosine construction. The intervening Table1 interrupts the paragraph in extracted reading order.

neighbor_context_ablation.remaining: Constant-path motivation, interpretability and Figure4 anaphora are still unsupported in expanded results. All150 original passages remain included; preserving text is not proof of unchanged generated-answer quality.
neighbor_context_ablation.decision: Do not enable blanket expansion: two recovered answers cost2.16x context. Investigate bounded structural/neighbor context and PDF reading order; ranking misses require separate treatment.

full_runtime_support_review.scope: Manual reference-support review of the fixed 30-question public-paper suite, candidate20/final5 with cached MiniLM reranker. Not blind, not independent, not a general production score. Existing five calibration cases plus newly inspected supporting passages; all five passages inspected for newly identified incomplete cases.

cases.note: Parallelization supported; constant long-range path/operation claim absent.

Averaging limitation and multiple learned projections supported; explicit joint attention to different representation subspaces at different positions absent. Conservative reference-support judgment, not inability to infer the mechanism.
Need to inject position information is retrieved; adding sine/cosine encodings to embeddings is not.
Abstract and Table2 support 41.8/3.5 days; retrieved body text instead says 41.0. Source inconsistency, not invented retrieval text; generation should flag it.
Grade matrix-sharing claim; reference's trailing 'similar to 1' is malformed citation text, source says [30].
Figure4 caption on source p14 explicitly names anaphora resolution, but results retrieve other material including Figure5 instead.
Single-head reduction of 0.9 BLEU retrieved, but neither requested 24.9 nor matching 25.8 development baseline is present. Source Table3 contains 24.9.

full_runtime_support_review.next_work: Target incomplete explanations, caption selection and table-row context. Compare support changes on this full suite before altering defaults; do not equate the 11 literal matches with 11 correct answers.

current_runtime_verification.method: Actual RAGPipeline construction, persisted-index reopen and search; existing public API query vectors supplied by an in-memory embedder, actual cached CUDA cross-encoder. Python socket.connect blocked; indexing raises if attempted. Candidate depth20, final5, no contextual enrichment.
current_runtime_verification.limits: Timing excludes query embedding/API latency. Source containment and citation presence do not establish semantic relevance or independently validate page ranges. Current runtime matches the prior full-passage replay; known interpretability miss remains. No user settings or live indexes changed.

full_suite_depth_and_reranker_replay.method: Reuse public index; batch all query embeddings once, preserve vectors and complete keyword/vector rankings. Replay RRF at candidate depths 5/20/76. Separately score all 76 passages per query using cached ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 on CUDA, then restrict candidates to depth 5/20/40/76 per retrieval branch. Five final passages throughout.
full_suite_depth_and_reranker_replay.calibration: Known supporting chunks remain in the final five for autoregression, label smoothing, attention scaling and sinusoidal preference in both RRF depths and all reranking depths. Interpretability chunk39 remains absent even after reranking the full corpus. F1 chunk52 reaches rank5 with RRF depth20 or with reranking depth5.
full_suite_depth_and_reranker_replay.limits: Literal containment is not a semantic score; other changed passages still need support review. Reranker replay scores the entire small corpus before filtering, so its timings are not production candidate-limited latency. No default change justified yet.

api_700_followup.method: Same public inputs, 700-character chunks, overlap 100 and top five; enable API vector retrieval plus existing keyword/RRF path. No reranking or contextual enrichment.
api_700_followup.conclusion: Actual API hybrid execution verified. No support-grade improvement on the five calibration cases; interpretability still missing. No overall quality or model-superiority claim. Full support review remains. Production defaults unchanged.

offline_stage_diagnosis.method: Rebuilt the identical 76 chunks in temporary lexical storage; requested up to 76 FTS candidates. No paid requests.
offline_stage_diagnosis.interpretability: Chunk 39 preserves both required claims together. Its FTS rank is 37, outside the five-candidate keyword pool. Parsing/chunking did not lose this answer. API vector candidate ranks were not recorded, so the API-specific exclusion stage remains unproven.
offline_stage_diagnosis.parsing_f1_query_24: Chunk 52 explicitly pairs Transformer (4 layers), semi-supervised and 92.7. FTS rank 3 reproduces the lexical baseline, but the API hybrid final five omit it. This is a genuine answer-support regression, consistent with displacement during fusion/final truncation; record actual vector and fused ranks next to confirm.
offline_stage_diagnosis.next_check: Compare a wider candidate pool on the full fixed suite and evaluate reranking for misses that remain; do not blindly enlarge chunks.

actual_api_stage_trace.method: Retrieve all 76 vector/keyword candidates once per query; replay existing RRF on prefixes of 5, 20 and 76 candidates with the same five-result cutoff. Same embedding model/chunks/settings; no production changes.
actual_api_stage_trace.conclusion: Five-candidate truncation hides the F1 passage from vector/keyword agreement; 20 candidates recover it into final rank 5. Widening alone does not fix interpretability even with the entire corpus. Two diagnostic cases are not enough to change defaults.

rubric.full: Retrieved top-five evidence explicitly supports every listed required claim, allowing paraphrases and evidence across passages.
rubric.partial: At least one but not every required claim is supported.
rubric.scope: Support for the reference answer, not generated-answer correctness. Claim requirements are manual calibration judgments, not a blind holdout. No aggregate quality estimate is warranted.

required_claims: Previously generated symbols become additional input for generating the next symbol.
Perplexity worsens because the model is less certain.
Large dot-product magnitudes put softmax in a region of very small gradients.
Individual attention heads exhibit distinct tasks related to syntactic and semantic structure.
They may permit extrapolation to sequences longer than those encountered during training.
